text:
sam: Heads up — apiserver error rate and controller-manager queue depth jumped ~10:22 UTC across eu-west1 and ap-south1. Seeing a bunch of lease renewal failures and transient leader switches.

ops-bot: ALERT: apiserver_lease_renewal_errors > 100 in 1m (eu-west1)

nora: I can see the same on the dashboard. latency P99 for /watch endpoints up to 1.4s, and leader flips around the same time window. GPU attach jobs are failing with timeouts.

priya: logs from one apiserver: `rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = transport: connection is closing` and `failed to refresh lease: etcdserver: request timed out`

sam: paste of journalctl snippet:
```
Mar 28 10:21:58 apiserver[1]: E0328 10:21:58.123456 1 rest.go:123] watch chan failed: etcdserver: mvcc: required revision not found
Mar 28 10:22:01 apiserver[1]: E0328 10:22:01.654321 1 storage_deletion.go:45] failed to persist lease: context deadline exceeded
```

nora: network counters on proxy nodes show bursts of retransmits and MTU mismatch warnings after the 10:20 deploy window. Not sure if it's related but proxy pods restarted ~3x in that interval.

jordan: I pulled `ss -tn` on a control-plane host, saw many TIME_WAIT + RSTs to etcd endpoints. Disk iops on etcd nodes spiked too (iostat showing avg await > 50ms).

priya: So we've got three signals: (1) network flakiness/proxy MTU, (2) etcd disk latency, (3) apiserver restarts -> lease churn. Any evidence it's tied to a specific config change?

sam: Deploys at 10:18 were a kube-proxy update to bump conntrack table size. Could be related — maybe kernel params not applied uniformly, causing packet fragmentation.

ops-bot: DEPLOY: kube-proxy 1.23.4 -> 1.23.5 (10:18 UTC) by ci/cd

nora: Rolling back kube-proxy would be disruptive. Short term mitigation idea: increase apiserver leader election lease duration and controller-manager retry backoff to avoid flapping while we triage.

priya: +1 for short-term config softening. Also propose disabling non-critical watch-heavy controllers in eu-west1 to reduce watch fanout while we stabilize.

jordan: I can patch apiserver flags on the active masters to `--lease-duration=30s --renew-deadline=20s` and controller-manager `--controllers=..., -remove some` (will list exact flags). Want me to proceed?

sam: Do it. Also revert the kube-proxy kernel param change in the canary pool if possible.

nora: Reverting in canary now. Monitoring for retransmits.

priya: I'm spinning up iops-monitoring job against etcd disks to capture more granularity. Will also check underlying host dmesg for IO scheduler issues.

jordan: Patch applied to masters in eu-west1. apiserver lease errors dropped within two minutes. controller-manager queue depth slowly decreasing.

ops-bot: INFO: apiserver_lease_renewal_errors back to baseline (eu-west1)

sam: Nice. But we still need a root cause. Next steps: (1) correlate kube-proxy change with MTU/retransmit spike (nora), (2) run fio on etcd hosts in maintenance window (priya), (3) audit kernel params across nodes for fragmentation/dfb (jordan).

nora: I'll also open a ticket to add stronger preflight checks for conntrack/kernel params in our kube-proxy rollout job.

priya: And I'll prepare a postmortem draft once we have fio results and can confirm whether disk latency was primary or secondary.

jordan: tagging @oncall to follow up in the morning.

sam: tl;dr — transient network / conntrack/MTU issue coincided with etcd disk latency, caused lease renewals to time out and spawned leader flips; temporary config softening stabilized clusters. Continuing triage. :thumbsup:
